mapper.select: SELECT STATUS AS "status" ,COUNT(*)::INT AS "count" FROM T_IDEA WHERE DEL_DAY IS NULL GROUP BY STATUS

SELECT ID AS "id" ,TITLE AS "title" ,BODY AS "body" ,STATUS AS "status" ,VOTE_COUNT AS "voteCount" FROM T_IDEA WHERE 1=1 AND DEL_DAY IS NULL AND STATUS <> 'REJECTED' ORDER BY VOTE_COUNT DESC, ID DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT ID AS "id" ,USER_ID AS "userId" ,TITLE AS "title" ,STATUS AS "status" FROM T_IDEA WHERE 1=1 AND ID = #{id} AND DEL_DAY IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_IDEA WHERE 1=1 AND USER_ID = #{userId} AND INS_DAY >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_IDEA (USER_ID, TITLE, BODY, CATEGORY) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{body}, #{category})
INSERT INTO T_IDEA_VOTE (IDEA_ID, USER_ID) VALUES (#{ideaId}, #{userId}) ON CONFLICT (IDEA_ID, USER_ID) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT VOTE_COUNT FROM T_IDEA WHERE ID = #{ideaId}
SELECT USER_ID FROM T_IDEA_VOTE WHERE IDEA_ID = #{ideaId}
